Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a business and occupation tax credit for hiring certain persons in manufacturing.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a business and occupation tax creditfor hiring certain persons in manufacturing; and adding a new sectionto chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, employers maytake a credit for the costs of training interns, apprentices, orpermanent employees in highdemand advanced manufacturing positions.Employers receiving the credit may not have more than one hundred fulltime equivalent employees on their payroll. (2) The credit allowed under this section is equal to fifty percentof the costs under subsection (1) of this section. The credit may notexceed five thousand dollars per employee. The credit earned by anemployer in one calendar year may be carried over to be creditedagainst taxes incurred in a subsequent calendar year. An employer maynot receive a credit in excess of two hundred thousand dollars peryear. (3) Employers claiming the credit provided in this section must: p. 1 SB 5249 (a) Have their training program certified by Impact Washington; and (b) File a complete annual survey with the department under RCW82.32.585.
